lines.zh: 翅膀拍击空气发出声响。
lines.en: Wings make a sound when flapping.
Circle low to find a target.
Its long tail steers from behind.
The wing membrane cups the warm updraft.
It glides far along the treetops.
A wingbeat drops it onto the ledge.
Pinned to the cliff, wings folded.

lines.zh: 岩壁上打个盹，翅膀还张着。
lines.en: Napping on the cliff with my wings still spread.

lines.zh: 翅膀偶尔发出轻微声响。

lines.en: It preens the wing membrane with its beak.
It hangs resting under the rock eaves.
Head tilted, it tracks an insect.

lines.zh: 我挂在岩壁上低头看你。
lines.en: I hang on the cliff and look down at you.

lines.zh: 翼膜绷紧，我从崖上滑下来。
lines.en: My wing membranes taut, I glide off the cliff.

lines.zh: 翼龙的喉咙里，只有嘶声。
lines.en: A pterosaur throat makes only hisses.

lines.zh: 它偏过头，只睁开一只眼
lines.en: It tilts its head and opens one eye.
Beak half open, it growls low.
A hole in my wing lets the wind through.
I open my jaws but only air comes out.
There is a tear in my wing membrane.
A tear opens in my wing membrane.
A bone is cracked. I can't fly.

lines.zh: 肉块散发诱惑，我准备降落。
lines.en: Flesh lure stirs, ready to land.

lines.zh: 猎物近在咫尺，我不会错过。
lines.en: Prey within reach, won't miss this.

lines.zh: 岩石裂缝中露出的鱼群，真诱人。
lines.en: School of fish in rock cracks, tempting.

lines.zh: 我闻到了新鲜的鱼肉，难以抗拒。
lines.en: Fresh fish scent, too tempting to resist.

lines.zh: 肉块在地面上吸引我，我得去。
lines.en: Meat on ground draws me, must check it.

lines.zh: 附近有食物，我得靠近看看。
我闻到了地面上的鱼腥味。
lines.en: Smell of fish on ground here.

lines.zh: 岩缝中鱼群游动，真美味。
lines.en: Fish swim in rock crevices, tasty.

lines.zh: 肉块引诱我，我准备靠近。
鱼腥味吸引我到这片区域。
翅膀在空中相撞，我失去平衡。
我撞上岩壁，翅膀被划伤。
翅膀碰到树枝，发出吱吱声。
lines.en: Wings hit branch, make a sound.

lines.zh: 我擦过岩壁，翅膀有划痕。
我的翅膀撞上树藤，发出声响。
lines.en: Wings hit vine, make a noise.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我偏离了飞行路线。
翅膀碰到岩壁，发出吱吱声。
lines.en: Wings hit rock, make a sound.

lines.zh: 我擦过地面，翅膀轻微划伤。
翅膀碰撞产生奇怪的声音。
寻找伴侣，鸣叫回响谷间。
lines.en: Call for mate, echo in valley.

lines.zh: 我在这里等着我的伴侣。
寻找伴侣时，我鸣叫求偶。
伴侣到来，我高兴地鸣叫。
lines.en: Mate arrives, I call in joy.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，我在空中盘旋。
我听到伴侣的声音，回应了。

lines.en: Dance with mate, calls in harmony.

lines.zh: 我从空中掠过，寻找猎物。
lines.en: I soar through the air, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 我是夜的使者，黑暗中的猎手。
lines.en: I am the messenger of night, the hunter in the dark.

lines.zh: 我用火焰唤醒沉睡的猎物。
lines.en: I wake slumbering prey with fire.

lines.zh: 风中传来了猎物的味道。
lines.en: The scent of prey wafts on the wind.

lines.zh: 我从梦中醒来，准备出击。
lines.en: I awaken from my slumber, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 我在空中巡逻，搜寻猎物。
lines.en: I patrol the skies, searching for prey.
I cover the sky with my wings.
I spot you in the updraft.

lines.zh: 我的利齿已经准备好了。

lines.en: I will devour it in my dreams.

lines.zh: 它颤抖着，即将成为我的。
lines.en: It trembles, about to be mine.
You stand out on open ground.
It lets go of the treetop branch.
Open ground makes a clean dive.
It marks the way you move.
My long beak aims at you.

lines.zh: 它将无法逃脱我的爪牙。
我的利爪将撕裂它的皮肉。
lines.en: My claws will tear its flesh.
It will be conquered by me.
It tucks its wings to drop.
Its tail tip levels at your position.
The wind shifts, and it will dive.

lines.zh: 用锋利的牙齿撕咬敌人！
发出震耳欲聋的嘶嘶声！
用翅膀扇动，让敌人窒息！
用强壮的爪子抓挠对手！
从空中俯冲下来，展开攻击！
在黑暗中发出嘶嘶声，吓退敌人！
用尖锐的喙啄击，造成伤害！
在战斗中发出低沉的咆哮声！
用强大的力量撞击敌人！

lines.en: Its beak jabs at your nape.
Wing claws dig into your shoulder.
Its long tail whips your face.

lines.zh: 它俯冲时撞弯了你的腿
在天空中翱翔，寻找栖息地！
lines.en: Fly in the sky, searching for a place!

lines.zh: 在岩石洞穴中孵化幼崽！

lines.en: Descend from wind, searching for food!

lines.zh: 在古老遗迹中孵化后代！
在岩层上孵化新的生命！
lines.en: Incubate new life on rock layers!

lines.zh: 在风暴中孵化出强大的幼龙！
在岩浆池边孵化出更加强大的个体！
lines.en: Hatch stronger individuals near lava pools!

lines.zh: 在古老遗迹的洞穴中孵化！
在风暴的呼啸中孵化出幼龙！

lines.en: A hatching cracks from the rock crevice.
It flaps out of the nest on all fours.
The first warm gust lifts it.
A winged shadow lands in the dawn light.
It tests its wings at the cliff edge.
It lifts off from a seaside cave.
It lands in the tree above you.
It arrives as the birds scatter.
Flame is singing my wing membrane.
I hit the cliff and slide down.
The blast tumbles me head over tail.
The arrow tears my wing membrane.

lines.zh: 翼膜被法术烫出一个洞。
lines.en: A spell burned a hole in my wing membrane.
Too hungry to beat my wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀在虚空里抓不到风。
lines.en: My wings find no wind in the void.
